HuskyAthletics

HuskyAthletics is a social platform connecting UW students through casual sports and recreation.

Overview: HuskyAthletics is a social platform designed to make it easier for UW students to discover, join, and organize sports activities. The platform connects students based on shared interests, skill levels, and availability, creating a more inclusive and accessible way to stay active and meet new people.

Survey

Signage Redesign · Odegaard Library, University of Washington

Odegaard Signage Redesign

Context

Odegaard’s third floor is being renovated over a year: new carpet and more accessible shelving.

Goal

Clear, phase-specific signs that explain closures with minimal inconvenience.

Original Sign

What wasn’t working

Header image is not necessary and can be used for content spaceToo many elements competing for attentionWellness room gets lost in textNo next steps or opportunity to orient readers

The Redesign

What improved

  • Improved Hierarchy
  • Better Organization
  • Increased Wellness Room Visual Prominence
  • Actionable Information
